newsitem.title: USA: Calif. refinances $273 million of bonds.
newsitem.headline: Calif. refinances $273 million of bonds.

text.p: California state Treasurer Matt Fong refinanced $273 million of state Public Works Board bonds on Wednesday, his office said.

The sale refinanced $89 million of California State University lease revenue bonds, $144 million of University of California lease revenue bonds and $40 million of lease revenue bonds from the California Department of Corrections, it said.

By refinancing the five series of bonds at a lower interest rate, the sale will save an estimated $14.6 million in lower debt service payments on bonds issued previously for various purposes, including campus facility leases, the treasurer's office said.

The bonds were sold in a negotiated sale by a team of underwriters led by Bear, Stearns & Co and co-managed by Alex. Brown & Sons, Artemis Capital Group, J.P. Morgan & Co., Lehman Brothers and Stephens Inc, it said.
